title: Count the Ducks! | Counting 1 to 5 Song for Kids
description: Count little ducks from 1 to 5 with a happy song! Great for toddlers and kids learning numbers.

scenes.line: One little duck is swimming in the pond. Quack!
Two little ducks, they are splashing all day long. Quack quack!
Three little ducks, come and join the happy song!
Four little ducks are dancing on the shore.
Five little ducks! Now let us count once more!
